title: Real per-tenant isolation: canonical paths, identity binding, live queues (VC-201-078)
goal: VC-201-078 refuted: workspace isolation is lexical starts_with — /t/alpha admits /t/alpha-evil and /t/alpha/../beta; register() silently rebinds a tenant to a different root/grants/quota with no ownership check; enqueue() only increments — no dequeue, so max_queue is a permanent wedge not a live bound; zero production callers. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_078_mastery.rs.
